name: Rolen Depot Steel-Toe Work Boot
description: Low-profile lace-up boot in scuffed black synth-leather with a visible steel toe cap and a thick rubber lug sole. Yellow contrast stitching around the welt is the only decorative element. Built to handle wet concrete floors and metal shavings without complaint.
functionality: Steel toe protection rated to 200J impact, oil-resistant sole, and waterproof seam sealing for wet industrial environments.
what_it_says: You don't think about your feet because these boots handle it — that's the whole point.
story_hooks: These boots are sold in bulk to three major corponations — meaning the same boot walks both sides of a labor dispute.
A pair found in a locker room has the steel toe cap removed and something else welded in — denser, heavier, custom.
